title: Add candidate signing status view
verified: signing.status.show renders TUI Signing Status as a read-only projection over candidate signatures and production signing readiness evidence.
Candidate detached signatures for dependency_inventory, sbom, update_metadata and provenance are labeled candidate-only and production_signature=false.
The panel renders algorithm, key_id, production_key_required and fail_closed policy from release provenance signing metadata.
Production signing status is explicitly separate from candidate signing; missing .prod.sig.json artifacts render missing_production_signature=true and production_ready=false.
Production signature verification result is linked when present and remains production_ready_claim=false.
TUI exposes signing_authority=false, production_signing_authority=false, direct_sign=false and direct_promote=false.
No private key path, private key material or secret-like value is rendered by the signing status view.
risk_notes: Candidate hash-bound signatures are never accepted as production signatures.
TUI reads signing artifacts only and never signs, verifies cryptographic material, promotes candidates or handles keys.
Production signing remains fail-closed until production keyring and production detached signatures are installed and verified outside the TUI.
TUI remains projection-controller only; AgentCore and SecurityExecutionEngine authority boundaries are unchanged.
